note: A gallery town with an established high-end buying culture and a festival built around it. Small artist field, wealthy crowd, long drive.

name: BAM Arts Fair 2027
note: Bellevue Arts Museum, last weekend of July, 275+ artists at Bellevue Square. Very wealthy Eastside audience but the fair is framed around handmade and design, so it leans craft — a solid volume filler rather than a place to sell a $6,000 piece.

name: Edmonds Arts Festival 2027
note: Pleasant Puget Sound show, well organised, moderate prices. Useful for filling the week before or after a bigger Northwest date.

name: Art Fair on the Square 2027
note: Around the Capitol, run by the Madison Museum of Contemporary Art. Big crowds and good gross sales; the price ceiling is Midwest-moderate.

name: Boston Mills Artfest 2027
note: Two consecutive weekends at a ski resort, well juried, with loyal Cleveland-Akron buyers. Doing both weekends makes the travel pay.

name: Cain Park Arts Festival 2027
note: Small, selective, and consistently well spoken of by exhibitors. A good low-risk filler in a strong Ohio July.

name: Columbus Arts Festival 2027
note: Large riverfront festival with a genuine fine art contingent inside a broad crowd. Volume more than ceiling.

name: Salt Fork Arts and Crafts Festival 2027
note: Long-running Ohio show with a better sales reputation than its size suggests. Cheap to do; treat it as a gap-filler, not a destination.

name: Sedona Arts Festival 2027
note: Established art town with resident buyers and October visitors. Small, scenic, and a reasonable way to open the Southwest season.

name: Vail Arts Festival 2027
note: Mountain-resort street show. The money is there but the format is browsing; useful the week before Cherry Creek if you are already in Colorado.

name: Beaver Creek Art Festival 2027
note: Same logic as Vail. Wealthy resort audience, promoter-run street format, modest expectations.

name: La Jolla Festival of the Arts 2027
note: Affluent coastal San Diego audience, ticketed, manageable size. A workable West Coast June date.

name: Palo Alto Festival of the Arts 2027
note: University Avenue street festival with tech-money foot traffic. High volume, mid-price buying.

name: Great Gulfcoast Arts Festival 2027
note: The Panhandle's one genuinely strong fine art weekend, and a useful early-November opener before the Florida season proper.
